memoryBuilder.verseText: You meant it for evil. But God meant it for good.

sequence.prompt: What happened to Joseph? Put it in order.

items.label: Jacob gave Joseph a coloured coat
Joseph told them about his dreams
His brothers sold him to traders
God was with Joseph in Egypt

matches.prompt: Match each one to what they did.

pairs.right: Sold their own brother to traders
Stayed with Joseph far from home

application.question: What the brothers did was wrong, and God did not pretend it was fine. When has something felt really unfair to you?
application.followUp: God never calls a wrong thing good. But He does not leave either — He stayed with Joseph the whole way, and He stays with you.
